entries.subject: m0
entries.title: Design published
entries.passMark: every page in the docs index exists, and every link resolves
entries.summary: Product, requirements, design, technical, kbui and roadmap docs are public, and every link resolves.

entries.subject: m1
entries.title: Clickable prototype
entries.passMark: all three problems can be walked forward and back with the line, picture and sentence in sync, on a public preview link

entries.subject: m2
entries.title: Python start-up check
entries.passMark: first walkthrough within 6 seconds over throttled 4G on a cold cache, and a 5,000-step trace in under 400 ms

entries.subject: m3
entries.title: Learner study
entries.passMark: at least 5 of 8 fix the bug faster with Stepwise, and at least 30% of walkthroughs use step-back or scrub

entries.subject: m4
entries.title: kbui release A
entries.passMark: a tagged kbui release with all seven, passing kbui's checks, installed in Stepwise from its release tarball

entries.subject: m5
entries.title: Run and trace
entries.passMark: traces for two problems match their stored copies exactly, a 5,000-step trace is ready in under 400 ms, and Stop ends an infinite loop within 100 ms without freezing the tab

entries.subject: m6
entries.title: First real walkthrough
entries.passMark: two problems work end to end. Each step draws in under 8 ms and scrubbing 5,000 steps stays above 50 fps

entries.subject: m7
entries.title: kbui release B
entries.passMark: a tagged kbui release with all nine, passing kbui's checks, installed in Stepwise

entries.subject: m8
entries.title: All six views
entries.passMark: the intended view is chosen for all 30 reference solutions, and the wrong one for no more than 15% of a set of common learner solutions

entries.subject: m9
entries.title: Feedback loop
entries.passMark: every planted bug (five per problem) opens at a useful step, no step is missing a sentence, and a minute of continuous typing in live mode never shows a blank view

entries.subject: m10
entries.title: Full library, accessible
entries.passMark: 30 problems live, no automated accessibility violations on any screen, the keyboard-only test passes, and a manual VoiceOver and NVDA check finds no blocking issues

entries.subject: m11
entries.title: Private beta
entries.passMark: 50 learners invited and active, at least 99.5% of sessions without a crash, and all [success measures](product.md#how-well-measure-it) reported after two weeks

entries.subject: m12
entries.title: v1
entries.passMark: in beta, 60% of new visitors finish a walkthrough in their first session and 25% return within a week

entries.subject: m13
entries.title: v2
entries.summary: Scope and pass mark set after M12.
